answer: Over 2026-03-13..2026-08-24 (165 days, notes retrieved 2026-08-24) the frozen [REDACTED] API notes carry 54 dated headings and the [REDACTED] changelog 42 dated entries. All seven catalog surfaces must be versioned: model_naming is the hottest (multiple GA launches and retirements), then tool_permission_model (computer_toolset_20260801 and permission_policy), then session_state and progress_streaming (removed compaction_control; event_deltas). output_schema had only one in-window [REDACTED] mention; the [REDACTED] output_format->output_config.format rename is 2026-01-29 (outside window) and is still a version pin. Timeout has the fewest notes (90s cell limit, httpx2 Timeout, 429 spend caps) but the constants still need a pin. [REDACTED] Code GitHub cadence is reported as published_at=138 vs created_at=137 and is not picked. Forecast: model_naming will see another GA id or retirement by 2026-11-22 (confidence 0.65-0.90).
